messages:
maria: FYI opening PR for model-catalog changes: adds supported variants for mistral-1 and llama3-lite, updates token limits, includes bench numbers and a small SDK snippet for quantized variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

jess: thanks! quick glance — token_limit for llama3-lite is 4096 in model-card but runtime reports 8192. which is right? :thinking:

yang: runtime change last month increased default context to 8192 for llama3-lite. docs should reflect both the model's maximum and per-plan enforced limits. suggest two lines in model card frontmatter: `context_max: 8192` and `enforced_for_hosted: 4096` (or similar)

sam: adding bench numbers (local gpularge with int8, 1 input, seq_len=512): p50=32ms p95=80ms p99=120ms. I'll paste formatted table in PR comment.

maria: thanks — do we have an SDK snippet showing how to call the quantized variant? PR currently uses `mistral-7b-q4f` but older SDKs didn't accept `-q` suffix consistently.

jess: snippet for python SDK (works on latest client):

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model="mistral-7b:q4f", input="Write a short haiku about compilers")
print(resp.output_text)
```

note: colon separator is the new canonical format, `mistral-7b:q4f` — update migration guide.

doc-bot: link-checker found one broken internal link in the model card: `../benchmarks/llama3` -> should be `../benchmarks/llama3b` — failing CI for docs site

yang: I'll fix the link and update the frontmatter. Also add a compatibility note: "quantized variants may not support function-calling / tool-calls due to tokenization differences" — is that accurate?

sam: yes for current runtime, q4f variants don't support streaming of function call tokens. add a short note in compatibility table and an entry in migration guide.

maria: OK assigning reviewers @jess @yang. I'll update PR with the python snippet, a JS snippet, the fixed link, and the frontmatter change. small follow-ups: update model-catalog index to show `supports_streaming: false` for q4f rows, and add the bench numbers. should be good for merge after reviews :+1:

jess: lgtm, will review in next hour.

maria: merged after jess review. closing thread.
